regime_context: Detector shows an extremely narrow, one-narrative tape: only 2 of 22 A-share themes are trend-eligible (Coal, Banks), breadth of rotation is just 0.09, and the absolute-trend gate did NOT reduce drawdown on this market's history (gate_helps=false) — so the validated drawdown-control edge is absent here and everything else is display/coincident. Momentum rank is an attention lens only (rank-IC ~0); rotation timing has no forward edge; crowding is a size-down caution, never a fade.
emerging_watch: Watching whether the Coal-to-Banks gap (margin 0.065, very tight) closes as a CONFIRMED handoff: if Banks overtakes Coal in score AND Coal's breadth drops below 0.3 while Banks holds breadth above 0.9, the one-narrative would shift to Banks — I would retire this watch if the margin between Coal and Banks widens back above 0.15 in Coal's favor without a breadth deterioration in Coal.

theses.subject: Coal
theses.thesis: Coal is the sole rank-1 leader and one of only two eligible themes (score 1.095, eligible=true), and it carries the one_narrative flag with cash at 0.5 yet breadth only 0.5. The trend-gate leg nominally supports participation, but because gate_helps=false on this market I treat the gate as experimental and default low. This is a directional lean on the ONLY confirmed leadership, not a rank-derived return forecast.
evidence: headline one_narrative=true with weight 0.25 and cash 0.5
theses.dissent: The hurst_tag is mean-revert (not trend), durability is barely above the bar, breadth is only 0.5, and on this history the trend gate has no drawdown edge — a mean-reverting leader in a whipsaw tape can reverse quickly.

theses.subject: Banks
theses.thesis: Banks is the challenger (score 1.03) and the only other eligible theme, with the strongest durability_bar (0.78), a confirmed trend hurst_tag, and the best breadth (0.944). However crowding_z=1.74 flags it as crowded=true, which is a SIZE-DOWN caution only — it supports continued participation but argues against chase-strengh conviction. The trend+durability legs are the only constructive signals and they are coincident, not predictive.
theses.dissent: Crowding is extreme (z=1.74, most crowded in the eligible set), and the guardrails forbid fading the leader but also warn crowding marks top-risk; with gate_helps=false there is no validated drawdown protection to lean on.
